copyright_note: Learner-facing metadata only. Problem statements and expected algorithm labels are not included here.

problems.title: Contains Duplicate
problems.abstract: Determine whether any value occurs more than once.
problems.expected_signal: Repeated membership checks over previously seen values.

problems.title: Valid Anagram
problems.abstract: Decide whether two strings have identical character multiplicities.
problems.expected_signal: Frequency state matters more than character order.

problems.title: Two Sum
problems.abstract: Find two distinct entries whose values add to a target.
problems.expected_signal: The current value asks whether a complement was seen earlier.

problems.title: Group Anagrams
problems.abstract: Group words that share the same character multiset.
problems.expected_signal: Equivalent objects can share one canonical key.

problems.title: Longest Consecutive Sequence
problems.abstract: Find the longest run of consecutive integer values without sorting as the main strategy.
problems.expected_signal: Fast arbitrary membership lets runs start only at missing predecessors.

problems.title: Top K Frequent Elements
problems.abstract: Return the values with the highest observed frequencies.
problems.expected_signal: Counting and top-K selection are separate subproblems.

problems.title: Valid Palindrome
problems.abstract: Check whether normalized characters match symmetrically from both ends.
problems.expected_signal: Two boundaries can move inward after each comparison.

problems.title: Two Sum II - Input Array Is Sorted
problems.abstract: Find a target-sum pair in ascending data.
problems.expected_signal: Sorted order makes one endpoint safely disposable after each sum comparison.

problems.title: Reverse String
problems.abstract: Reverse characters in place.
problems.expected_signal: Symmetric positions can be exchanged while boundaries converge.

problems.title: Container With Most Water
problems.abstract: Choose two vertical boundaries maximizing enclosed area.
problems.expected_signal: Width always shrinks, so only improving the limiting height can help.

problems.title: 3Sum
problems.abstract: Return unique triples whose values sum to zero.
problems.expected_signal: Sorting turns a three-choice search into one fixed value plus monotonic pair search.

problems.title: Trapping Rain Water
problems.abstract: Compute water retained between elevation bars.
problems.expected_signal: The smaller known boundary limits what can be finalized from that side.

problems.title: Maximum Average Subarray I
problems.abstract: Find the best average among all fixed-length contiguous ranges.
problems.expected_signal: Adjacent fixed-size ranges differ by one entering and one leaving value.

problems.title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
problems.abstract: Find the longest contiguous substring with unique characters.
problems.expected_signal: A moving range can shrink only when duplicate state becomes invalid.

problems.title: Longest Repeating Character Replacement
problems.abstract: Find the longest substring transformable to one repeated character under a replacement budget.
problems.expected_signal: Window size minus dominant frequency measures required edits.

problems.title: Permutation in String
problems.abstract: Detect whether a fixed-length substring has the same character counts as a pattern.
problems.expected_signal: A fixed window needs incremental frequency comparison.

problems.title: Minimum Window Substring
problems.abstract: Find the shortest substring covering all required multiplicities.
problems.expected_signal: Expand until coverage is valid, then shrink while preserving coverage.

problems.title: Minimum Size Subarray Sum
problems.abstract: Find the shortest positive-number subarray reaching a target sum.
problems.expected_signal: With positive values, expanding cannot reduce sum and shrinking cannot increase it.

problems.title: Valid Parentheses
problems.abstract: Validate nested bracket matching.
problems.expected_signal: The newest unresolved opener must close first.

problems.title: Implement Queue using Stacks
problems.abstract: Emulate FIFO behavior using LIFO structures.
problems.expected_signal: The exercise is about preserving removal order across transfers.

problems.title: Evaluate Reverse Polish Notation
problems.abstract: Evaluate an expression written in postfix notation.
problems.expected_signal: An operator consumes the most recent unresolved operands.

problems.title: Min Stack
problems.abstract: Support stack operations plus constant-time minimum queries.
problems.expected_signal: Each pushed state can remember the aggregate minimum up to that point.

problems.title: Decode String
problems.abstract: Expand nested repetition expressions.
problems.expected_signal: Nested contexts must resume in reverse order of opening.

problems.title: Simplify Path
problems.abstract: Normalize a Unix-style path with parent/current directory tokens.
problems.expected_signal: Parent-directory operations cancel the most recent retained segment.

problems.title: Binary Search
problems.abstract: Locate a target in ascending values.
problems.expected_signal: A midpoint comparison proves one half cannot contain the target.

problems.title: Search Insert Position
problems.abstract: Find where a target exists or should be inserted in sorted order.
problems.expected_signal: The answer is the first position not smaller than the target.

problems.title: Find First and Last Position of Element in Sorted Array
problems.abstract: Return both boundaries of a repeated target in sorted data.
problems.expected_signal: The task asks for boundary locations, not any matching index.

problems.title: Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array
problems.abstract: Find the minimum of a distinct sorted array after rotation.
problems.expected_signal: One side of the midpoint comparison still reveals which side contains the rotation boundary.

problems.title: Koko Eating Bananas
problems.abstract: Find the smallest processing rate that meets a deadline.
problems.expected_signal: If a rate works, every faster rate also works.

problems.title: Capacity To Ship Packages Within D Days
problems.abstract: Find the minimum capacity that completes ordered shipments within a day limit.
problems.expected_signal: Feasibility changes monotonically as capacity increases.

problems.title: Kth Largest Element in a Stream
problems.abstract: Track the kth largest value while new values arrive.
problems.expected_signal: The candidate set changes while a top-K boundary must be maintained.

problems.title: Last Stone Weight
problems.abstract: Repeatedly remove the two largest current values and possibly insert a remainder.
problems.expected_signal: Repeated best-element extraction occurs on a changing set.

problems.title: K Closest Points to Origin
problems.abstract: Return K points with the smallest distance scores.
problems.expected_signal: Only a top-K boundary matters, not a complete ordering of all points.

problems.title: Kth Largest Element in an Array
problems.abstract: Find one order statistic rather than sorting for output.
problems.expected_signal: The problem needs one rank boundary, so full ordering may be unnecessary.

problems.title: Find Median from Data Stream
problems.abstract: Maintain the median while values arrive online.
problems.expected_signal: Two balanced priority regions can expose the center after every insertion.

problems.title: Merge k Sorted Lists
problems.abstract: Merge many individually sorted linked sequences.
problems.expected_signal: Only the current head from each source competes for the next global minimum.

problems.title: Reverse Linked List
problems.abstract: Reverse all next pointers of a singly linked chain.
problems.expected_signal: Local rewiring must preserve the unprocessed suffix before changing a pointer.

problems.title: Merge Two Sorted Lists
problems.abstract: Merge two ordered node chains while reusing nodes.
problems.expected_signal: Only the two current heads can be the next output node.

problems.title: Linked List Cycle
problems.abstract: Determine whether following next pointers eventually revisits a node.
problems.expected_signal: Two traversal speeds reveal repetition without storing every node.

problems.title: Middle of the Linked List
problems.abstract: Return the middle node without knowing the length first.
problems.expected_signal: One pointer moving twice as fast encodes half-position progress.

problems.title: Remove Nth Node From End of List
problems.abstract: Remove a node positioned relative to the list tail in one pass.
problems.expected_signal: A fixed gap between two pointers converts tail-relative position to forward traversal.

problems.title: Reorder List
problems.abstract: Interleave nodes from the front and reversed back half in place.
problems.expected_signal: The task decomposes into middle finding, reversal, and two-chain merge.

problems.title: Maximum Depth of Binary Tree
problems.abstract: Compute the longest root-to-leaf depth.
problems.expected_signal: The answer for one node combines the same answer from its child subtrees.

problems.title: Invert Binary Tree
problems.abstract: Swap left and right structure throughout a binary tree.
problems.expected_signal: The same local transformation applies recursively to every subtree.

problems.title: Same Tree
problems.abstract: Determine whether two trees have identical structure and values.
problems.expected_signal: Paired subtree states must agree recursively at every node.

problems.title: Validate Binary Search Tree
problems.abstract: Verify global BST ordering across every descendant.
problems.expected_signal: Each node inherits valid value bounds from all ancestors.

problems.title: Kth Smallest Element in a BST
problems.abstract: Return one rank from a binary search tree.
problems.expected_signal: Inorder traversal converts BST ordering into sorted visitation.

problems.title: Lowest Common Ancestor of a Binary Tree
problems.abstract: Find the deepest node whose subtree contains both targets.
problems.expected_signal: A parent combines whether each target was found in separate child subtrees.

problems.title: Fibonacci Number
problems.abstract: Compute a recurrence from smaller inputs.
problems.expected_signal: A clear base case and smaller self-similar calls expose recursion mechanics.

problems.title: Pow(x, n)
problems.abstract: Compute exponentiation efficiently for an integer exponent.
problems.expected_signal: Halving the exponent creates a smaller instance whose result can be reused.

problems.title: Swap Nodes in Pairs
problems.abstract: Swap each adjacent linked-list pair while preserving the rest.
problems.expected_signal: After handling the first pair, the remainder is the same smaller problem.

problems.title: K-th Symbol in Grammar
problems.abstract: Determine one symbol in a recursively defined binary grammar row.
problems.expected_signal: The target position maps to a parent position in the previous row.

problems.title: All Possible Full Binary Trees
problems.abstract: Construct all full binary tree shapes with a fixed odd node count.
problems.expected_signal: Choose a left subtree size, then combine recursively generated left/right shapes.

problems.title: Construct Quad Tree
problems.abstract: Recursively partition a binary grid into uniform quadrants.
problems.expected_signal: A non-uniform region decomposes into four smaller regions with the same contract.

problems.title: Subsets
problems.abstract: Generate every subset of a distinct set of values.
problems.expected_signal: Each item contributes an include/skip decision and N is small.

problems.title: Permutations
problems.abstract: Generate every ordering of distinct values.
problems.expected_signal: Build one path while tracking which choices remain unused.

problems.title: Combination Sum
problems.abstract: Generate combinations reaching a target with reusable candidates.
problems.expected_signal: Partial choices can stop when remaining target becomes impossible.

problems.title: Letter Combinations of a Phone Number
problems.abstract: Generate strings by choosing one mapped character for each digit.
problems.expected_signal: One decision level corresponds to one input position.

problems.title: Word Search
problems.abstract: Determine whether a word can be formed by a non-reusing path through a grid.
problems.expected_signal: Choose a neighbor, mark it unavailable, explore, then restore on failure.

problems.title: N-Queens
problems.abstract: Construct all non-attacking queen placements.
problems.expected_signal: Partial placements expose column/diagonal conflicts that can prune whole branches.

problems.title: Find if Path Exists in Graph
problems.abstract: Determine whether two vertices are connected by some path.
problems.expected_signal: Entities and undirected edges naturally form adjacency relationships.

problems.title: Number of Provinces
problems.abstract: Count connected groups represented by a connectivity matrix.
problems.expected_signal: The matrix encodes an undirected graph whose components matter.

problems.title: Clone Graph
problems.abstract: Deep-copy a connected graph while preserving neighbor relations.
problems.expected_signal: Nodes can be revisited through cycles, so identity mapping is required.

problems.title: Keys and Rooms
problems.abstract: Determine whether all rooms become reachable through keys found in rooms.
problems.expected_signal: Keys define directed reachability edges from discovered states.

problems.title: Find the Town Judge
problems.abstract: Find a vertex trusted by everyone else that trusts nobody.
problems.expected_signal: The desired node is characterized by a directed indegree/outdegree signature.

problems.title: Find Center of Star Graph
problems.abstract: Identify the unique center shared by every edge of a star graph.
problems.expected_signal: Graph shape itself may allow a direct structural deduction without traversal.

problems.title: Number of Islands
problems.abstract: Count connected land components in a grid.
problems.expected_signal: Each unvisited land cell can seed one component traversal.

problems.title: Flood Fill
problems.abstract: Recolor all connected cells sharing the starting color.
problems.expected_signal: Reachability through equal-valued neighbors defines one component.

problems.title: Rotting Oranges
problems.abstract: Compute time for a simultaneous spread process across grid neighbors.
problems.expected_signal: Multiple starting sources expand in equal-time layers.

problems.title: Shortest Path in Binary Matrix
problems.abstract: Find the fewest equal-cost grid moves from one corner to another.
problems.expected_signal: Every legal step has equal cost, so first-discovery layers represent distance.

problems.title: Surrounded Regions
problems.abstract: Flip regions that are not connected to the board boundary.
problems.expected_signal: It is easier to mark the boundary-connected exceptions than test every enclosed region directly.

problems.title: Pacific Atlantic Water Flow
problems.abstract: Find cells that can reach two different boundaries under height constraints.
problems.expected_signal: Reverse the flow condition and traverse inward from both destination sets.

problems.title: Redundant Connection
problems.abstract: Find an undirected edge that closes a cycle when added.
problems.expected_signal: An edge is redundant exactly when its endpoints are already in one component.

problems.title: Accounts Merge
problems.abstract: Merge account records that share identifiers.
problems.expected_signal: Shared identifiers create equivalence classes that only merge.

problems.title: Number of Operations to Make Network Connected
problems.abstract: Determine how many reconnections are needed to join all network components.
problems.expected_signal: Component count and redundant edges matter more than actual routes.

problems.title: Satisfiability of Equality Equations
problems.abstract: Check whether equality and inequality constraints can coexist.
problems.expected_signal: Equalities create equivalence classes; inequalities must not fall inside one class.

problems.title: Most Stones Removed with Same Row or Column
problems.abstract: Maximize removals while row/column connectivity preserves at least one stone per component.
problems.expected_signal: The final removable count depends on number of connected components, not removal order.

problems.title: Remove Max Number of Edges to Keep Graph Fully Traversable
problems.abstract: Keep enough shared/private edges to connect two users while removing the rest.
problems.expected_signal: Connectivity merges must be tracked separately while prioritizing shared useful edges.

problems.title: Course Schedule
problems.abstract: Decide whether all prerequisite courses can be completed.
problems.expected_signal: A directed dependency cycle is exactly the obstruction.

problems.title: Course Schedule II
problems.abstract: Return one order satisfying all course prerequisites.
problems.expected_signal: Only nodes with no unresolved prerequisites can be chosen next.

problems.title: Course Schedule IV
problems.abstract: Answer many prerequisite reachability queries among courses.
problems.expected_signal: Directed dependency structure plus many queries may require propagated prerequisite information.

problems.title: Find All Possible Recipes from Given Supplies
problems.abstract: Produce recipes when all ingredients become available through supplies or earlier recipes.
problems.expected_signal: Availability removes unresolved prerequisites and may unlock new nodes.

problems.title: Parallel Courses III
problems.abstract: Find minimum completion time for duration-weighted prerequisite tasks that may run in parallel.
problems.expected_signal: A dependency order makes longest prerequisite completion time a DAG state transition.

problems.title: Find Eventual Safe States
problems.abstract: Find directed nodes whose every path eventually terminates.
problems.expected_signal: Reverse dependency elimination or cycle-aware DFS identifies nodes not trapped by cycles.

problems.title: Network Delay Time
problems.abstract: Find when all nodes receive a signal sent through non-negative weighted edges.
problems.expected_signal: The next useful frontier node is the one with smallest accumulated arrival time.

problems.title: Path With Minimum Effort
problems.abstract: Minimize the maximum edge effort along a grid path.
problems.expected_signal: Path state has a monotonic best-known cost that can order frontier exploration.

problems.title: Path with Maximum Probability
problems.abstract: Find a path maximizing product of non-negative edge probabilities.
problems.expected_signal: Best-first frontier logic still works when path quality combines monotonically by multiplication.

problems.title: Swim in Rising Water
problems.abstract: Minimize the highest elevation encountered on a path through a grid.
problems.expected_signal: The path cost is the maximum seen so far, and best-first expansion can settle lower thresholds first.

problems.title: Cheapest Flights Within K Stops
problems.abstract: Find a cheap route subject to a bound on number of intermediate stops.
problems.expected_signal: Distance alone is not the whole state; remaining/used stops changes future legality.

problems.title: Number of Ways to Arrive at Destination
problems.abstract: Count how many minimum-cost routes reach the destination.
problems.expected_signal: Shortest-distance relaxation must also aggregate equal-best predecessor counts.

problems.title: Assign Cookies
problems.abstract: Maximize satisfied children by matching resource sizes to minimum requirements.
problems.expected_signal: After sorting, using the smallest sufficient resource preserves larger resources for harder needs.

problems.title: Jump Game
problems.abstract: Determine whether variable-length forward jumps can reach the last index.
problems.expected_signal: Only the farthest reachable boundary matters; exact path history can be discarded.

problems.title: Jump Game II
problems.abstract: Find the fewest jumps needed to reach the end when reachability is guaranteed.
problems.expected_signal: Each jump selects the best next reachable frontier rather than one exact next position.

problems.title: Gas Station
problems.abstract: Find a circular start point that completes a route with fuel gains and costs.
problems.expected_signal: A failed prefix proves every start inside that failed segment also fails.

problems.title: Partition Labels
problems.abstract: Partition a string so each character appears in at most one part.
problems.expected_signal: A segment can close when the current position reaches the farthest last occurrence seen inside it.

problems.title: Boats to Save People
problems.abstract: Pair people under a boat weight limit while minimizing boat count.
problems.expected_signal: The heaviest remaining person must take a boat; only the lightest person can possibly share it.

problems.title: Range Sum Query - Immutable
problems.abstract: Answer repeated range sums on an immutable array.
problems.expected_signal: Queries reuse overlapping prefixes of static data.

problems.title: Find Pivot Index
problems.abstract: Find an index where left and right sums are equal.
problems.expected_signal: Total and running prefix let each side be derived without rescanning.

problems.title: Subarray Sum Equals K
problems.abstract: Count contiguous subarrays whose sum equals a target, including negative values.
problems.expected_signal: A range sum equals the difference of two prefix sums; earlier prefix frequencies matter.

problems.title: Contiguous Array
problems.abstract: Find the longest binary subarray containing equal counts of two symbols.
problems.expected_signal: Transform one symbol to -1 so equal counts become repeated prefix balance.

problems.title: Subarray Sums Divisible by K
problems.abstract: Count subarrays whose sum is divisible by K.
problems.expected_signal: Two prefix sums with the same remainder differ by a multiple of K.

problems.title: Range Sum Query 2D - Immutable
problems.abstract: Answer repeated rectangle-sum queries on a fixed matrix.
problems.expected_signal: Two-dimensional cumulative inclusion/exclusion can isolate any rectangle.

problems.title: Merge Intervals
problems.abstract: Combine overlapping ranges into disjoint coverage.
problems.expected_signal: Sorting by start makes only the current merged tail relevant to the next interval.

problems.title: Insert Interval
problems.abstract: Insert one range into sorted non-overlapping ranges and merge as needed.
problems.expected_signal: Intervals naturally divide into before, overlapping, and after regions.

problems.title: Non-overlapping Intervals
problems.abstract: Remove as few ranges as possible so the rest do not overlap.
problems.expected_signal: Keeping the interval that finishes earlier leaves at least as much room for future ranges.

problems.title: Minimum Number of Arrows to Burst Balloons
problems.abstract: Use as few points as possible to hit all closed intervals.
problems.expected_signal: Overlapping intervals can share one action placed before their common right boundary disappears.

problems.title: Remove Covered Intervals
problems.abstract: Count ranges not fully contained by another range.
problems.expected_signal: A careful sort turns containment into a one-pass boundary comparison.

problems.title: Divide Intervals Into Minimum Number of Groups
problems.abstract: Assign intervals to the fewest groups with no overlap inside a group.
problems.expected_signal: The answer is the maximum number of simultaneously active intervals.

problems.title: Climbing Stairs
problems.abstract: Count ways to reach a step using one- or two-step moves.
problems.expected_signal: Different recursion branches repeatedly ask for the number of ways from the same remaining step.

problems.title: Min Cost Climbing Stairs
problems.abstract: Find the minimum accumulated cost to move beyond the final stair.
problems.expected_signal: Define the minimum cost to reach each position from two predecessor states.

problems.title: N-th Tribonacci Number
problems.abstract: Compute a recurrence depending on the previous three states.
problems.expected_signal: A tiny fixed dependency frontier means repeated recursion can become iterative state.

problems.title: Decode Ways
problems.abstract: Count valid decodings of a digit string under one- and two-digit rules.
problems.expected_signal: The count for a prefix depends on whether its final one/two digits form legal choices.

problems.title: Word Break
problems.abstract: Determine whether a string can be segmented into dictionary words.
problems.expected_signal: Many segmentation paths reach the same suffix/prefix boundary state.

problems.title: Coin Change
problems.abstract: Find the fewest reusable coins needed to reach an amount.
problems.expected_signal: Remaining amount defines repeated subproblems; arbitrary denominations defeat naive greedy rules.

problems.title: House Robber
problems.abstract: Maximize selected values while forbidding adjacent choices.
problems.expected_signal: At each index, compare skipping it with taking it plus the best compatible earlier prefix.

problems.title: House Robber II
problems.abstract: Solve the same adjacent-choice optimization on a circular sequence.
problems.expected_signal: The first/last conflict can be removed by splitting into two linear cases.

problems.title: Integer Break
problems.abstract: Split an integer into at least two positive parts maximizing product.
problems.expected_signal: Best result for n can be built from best results for smaller remaining sums.

problems.title: Delete and Earn
problems.abstract: Taking a value earns all its occurrences but forbids adjacent numeric values.
problems.expected_signal: Aggregate equal values, then the remaining conflict is a linear adjacent-choice problem.

problems.title: Maximum Product Subarray
problems.abstract: Find the contiguous subarray with maximum product.
problems.expected_signal: A negative value swaps the roles of best and worst product ending at a position.

problems.title: Maximum Subarray
problems.abstract: Find the contiguous subarray with maximum sum.
problems.expected_signal: The best sum ending here either starts here or extends the best positive ending before it.

problems.title: Unique Paths
problems.abstract: Count right/down paths through a rectangular grid.
problems.expected_signal: Ways to one cell combine ways from the two predecessor coordinates.

problems.title: Minimum Path Sum
problems.abstract: Find the minimum right/down path cost through a grid.
problems.expected_signal: Each cell's best cost depends on best costs from top and left.

problems.title: Longest Common Subsequence
problems.abstract: Find the longest order-preserving sequence shared by two strings.
problems.expected_signal: A state needs one prefix boundary from each string.

problems.title: Edit Distance
problems.abstract: Find the fewest character edits converting one string to another.
problems.expected_signal: Each state compares two prefixes and considers insert/delete/replace predecessor states.

problems.title: Maximal Square
problems.abstract: Find the largest all-one square inside a binary matrix.
problems.expected_signal: Square size ending at a cell is limited by three neighboring square states.

problems.title: Minimum Falling Path Sum
problems.abstract: Find a minimum-cost top-to-bottom path with diagonal movement choices.
problems.expected_signal: Each cell state depends on a small predecessor window in the previous row.

problems.title: Partition Equal Subset Sum
problems.abstract: Decide whether values can split into two equal-sum groups.
problems.expected_signal: The problem reduces to whether one subset can reach half the total sum.

problems.title: Target Sum
problems.abstract: Count sign assignments that reach a target total.
problems.expected_signal: Choice counts can be transformed into a bounded subset-sum state.

problems.title: Coin Change II
problems.abstract: Count combinations of reusable coins reaching an amount.
problems.expected_signal: Resource amount is the state; loop order determines whether combinations or permutations are counted.

problems.title: Combination Sum IV
problems.abstract: Count ordered sequences of reusable values summing to a target.
problems.expected_signal: Changing iteration order changes whether ordering is part of the state/count.

problems.title: Last Stone Weight II
problems.abstract: Partition weights to minimize the difference between two group sums.
problems.expected_signal: Minimizing final difference is equivalent to finding a subset sum near half the total.

problems.title: Profitable Schemes
problems.abstract: Count subsets under member capacity that reach at least a profit threshold.
problems.expected_signal: Two bounded resources/progress dimensions turn subset choice into multidimensional knapsack state.

problems.title: Longest Increasing Subsequence
problems.abstract: Find the longest strictly increasing subsequence.
problems.expected_signal: First define the best subsequence ending at each index before optimizing it.

problems.title: Number of Longest Increasing Subsequence
problems.abstract: Count how many subsequences achieve maximum increasing length.
problems.expected_signal: Each ending state needs both best length and number of ways attaining it.

problems.title: Maximum Length of Pair Chain
problems.abstract: Build the longest chain of ordered pairs under an endpoint relation.
problems.expected_signal: The problem resembles sequence extension but may also expose a greedy ordering shortcut.

problems.title: Russian Doll Envelopes
problems.abstract: Nest the maximum number of envelopes under two-dimensional strict inequalities.
problems.expected_signal: Sort one dimension carefully so the second dimension becomes a one-dimensional subsequence problem.

problems.title: Longest Arithmetic Subsequence
problems.abstract: Find the longest subsequence with constant difference.
problems.expected_signal: Index alone is insufficient; the ending state also needs the chosen difference.

problems.title: Longest Arithmetic Subsequence of Given Difference
problems.abstract: Find the longest subsequence whose adjacent values differ by a fixed amount.
problems.expected_signal: A value-keyed state can extend the best chain ending at value minus the required difference.

problems.title: Next Greater Element I
problems.abstract: Find each value's first greater value to the right in another sequence.
problems.expected_signal: Earlier unresolved values can be finalized when a new larger value arrives.

problems.title: Daily Temperatures
problems.abstract: For each day, find how long until a warmer day.
problems.expected_signal: Unresolved indices stay ordered by temperature until a warmer value pops them.

problems.title: Online Stock Span
problems.abstract: For each arriving price, count consecutive prior prices no greater than it.
problems.expected_signal: Dominated prior prices can be compressed into spans when popped.

problems.title: Largest Rectangle in Histogram
problems.abstract: Find the largest rectangle supported by consecutive histogram bars.
problems.expected_signal: Each bar needs the nearest smaller boundary on both sides.

problems.title: Sum of Subarray Minimums
problems.abstract: Sum the minimum value of every contiguous subarray.
problems.expected_signal: Count how many subarrays use each element as the chosen minimum via nearest smaller boundaries.

problems.title: Remove K Digits
problems.abstract: Delete K digits to produce the smallest possible remaining number.
problems.expected_signal: A larger digit before a smaller incoming digit is dominated and should be removed while budget remains.

problems.title: Sliding Window Maximum
problems.abstract: Return the maximum value in every fixed-size moving window.
problems.expected_signal: Expired indices must leave while dominated smaller values can never become future maxima.

problems.title: Longest Continuous Subarray With Absolute Diff Less Than or Equal to Limit
problems.abstract: Find the longest window whose max-minus-min stays within a limit.
problems.expected_signal: Window validity depends on maintaining both moving extrema efficiently.

problems.title: Shortest Subarray with Sum at Least K
problems.abstract: Find the shortest subarray reaching a target sum when values may be negative.
problems.expected_signal: Ordinary sum windows fail; prefix sums need a deque of undominated candidate starts.

problems.title: Jump Game VI
problems.abstract: Maximize path score when each state can jump from one of the previous K positions.
problems.expected_signal: Each DP state needs the maximum over a moving window of previous states.

problems.title: Constrained Subsequence Sum
problems.abstract: Maximize subsequence sum with a bound on index gaps.
problems.expected_signal: The transition asks for the best previous DP value inside a sliding index window.

problems.title: Max Value of Equation
problems.abstract: Maximize a pair equation under a bound on x-distance in sorted points.
problems.expected_signal: Rearrange the expression so one term is a moving-window maximum of prior candidates.

problems.title: Implement Trie (Prefix Tree)
problems.abstract: Support exact-word and prefix queries over inserted strings.
problems.expected_signal: Many strings share prefix paths and exact-word endings need separate markers.

problems.title: Design Add and Search Words Data Structure
problems.abstract: Store words and search patterns that may contain wildcard characters.
problems.expected_signal: Prefix transitions are deterministic until a wildcard branches across children.

problems.title: Replace Words
problems.abstract: Replace words with the shortest dictionary prefix that matches them.
problems.expected_signal: Search should stop at the first terminal node along a prefix path.

problems.title: Map Sum Pairs
problems.abstract: Store string keys with values and query sums for all keys sharing a prefix.
problems.expected_signal: Prefix nodes can aggregate information for every key below them.

problems.title: Search Suggestions System
problems.abstract: Return limited lexicographic suggestions after each typed prefix.
problems.expected_signal: Every added character narrows a prefix range/path; ordering and prefix retrieval interact.

problems.title: Word Search II
problems.abstract: Find many dictionary words in a board without searching each word independently.
problems.expected_signal: Shared dictionary prefixes can prune board backtracking for many words at once.

problems.title: Single Number
problems.abstract: Find the value appearing once when every other value appears twice.
problems.expected_signal: Pairwise duplicates cancel under XOR while the unique value remains.

problems.title: Number of 1 Bits
problems.abstract: Count set bits in an integer representation.
problems.expected_signal: Repeatedly removing or testing set-bit positions avoids string conversion.

problems.title: Counting Bits
problems.abstract: Return set-bit counts for every integer from zero through N.
problems.expected_signal: Removing the lowest set bit or shifting links each number to a smaller known state.

problems.title: Reverse Bits
problems.abstract: Reverse the fixed-width bit representation of an integer.
problems.expected_signal: The task is positional manipulation of binary digits, not arithmetic magnitude.

problems.title: Missing Number
problems.abstract: Find the missing value from a complete zero-through-N range.
problems.expected_signal: Expected indices and present values can cancel pairwise without extra storage.

problems.title: Sum of Two Integers
problems.abstract: Add two integers without using arithmetic addition/subtraction operators.
problems.expected_signal: XOR computes carry-free sum bits while AND+shift computes carry bits.

problems.title: Sum of All Subset XOR Totals
problems.abstract: Aggregate an XOR score over every subset of a small array.
problems.expected_signal: Each subset can be represented by include/exclude bits.

problems.title: Maximum Length of a Concatenated String with Unique Characters
problems.abstract: Choose strings whose concatenation has no repeated character and maximize total length.
problems.expected_signal: Small fixed alphabet enables compact used-character masks during subset choices.

problems.title: Partition to K Equal Sum Subsets
problems.abstract: Partition values into K groups with equal target sums.
problems.expected_signal: Small N allows subset state, while partial group constraints enable pruning/memoization.

problems.title: Smallest Sufficient Team
problems.abstract: Choose the fewest people whose skills cover all required skills.
problems.expected_signal: Required-skill coverage is a compact subset mask that can index best-known teams.

problems.title: Shortest Path Visiting All Nodes
problems.abstract: Find the shortest walk that has visited every graph node at least once.
problems.expected_signal: Location alone is insufficient; visited-node subset must be part of the search state.

problems.title: Maximum Compatibility Score Sum
problems.abstract: Pair students with mentors to maximize total compatibility.
problems.expected_signal: Small assignment size makes used-mentor subset a compact exponential state.
